name: Bali
tagline: Rice terraces, jungle swings and temple gates.
description: Island-of-the-gods travel photos: Ubud's rice terraces, a jungle swing, temple gates (with the sarong and sash temples ask visitors to wear), waterfalls, villa breakfasts, palm-lined scooter rides, yoga shalas and Uluwatu sunsets. Lush greens and soft tropical light.
